info.title: GDMR Connect API
info.description: REST API of the GDMR Connect HRIS. Generated from the source code (tools/generate_api_docs.py). All request/response bodies are JSON unless a route is marked multipart/form-data. Log in with POST /api/login and send the returned token as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'.

servers.description: Production (the same API is also reachable at https://www.gdmrconnect.com/api/… through the website proxy)

tags.name: System, Health & Files
tags.description: Service health checks and the legacy file-serving route.

tags.name: Authentication & Passwords
tags.description: Login, password change, emailed password-reset links, log out of all devices and admin force-logout. Everything else in the API needs the token these routes issue.

tags.name: Two-Step Verification (MFA)
tags.description: Optional authenticator-app verification: second login step, set-up, backup codes, turn-off, and admin reset.

tags.name: Special Access (Delegated Permissions)
tags.description: Admins/owners grant an employee temporary access to chosen admin modules. These routes create, list and revoke those grants.

tags.name: Employees, Managers, Departments
tags.description: The employee register: create/edit/remove staff, managers and admins, departments and heads, resignation/offboarding, profile lock, extended leave settings and personal-file documents.

tags.name: Attendance — Check-in / Check-out
tags.description: Photo check-in and check-out and the caller's own attendance history, plus the admin attendance listing.

tags.name: Attendance Reports & Exports
tags.description: Monthly/yearly attendance reports as PDF, CSV and Excel, including the multi-sheet Master Tracker.

tags.name: Biometric Devices
tags.description: Admin management of fingerprint/face devices and the device-facing ADMS endpoints (/iclock/*) that devices call directly.

tags.name: Holidays & Attendance Calendar
tags.description: Company holidays, attendance corrections and the calendar views built from them.

tags.name: Leave Management
tags.description: Apply for leave (with attachment), approve/reject, revoke, comp-off credits and balances.

tags.name: Payroll
tags.description: Salary structures, monthly payslips, loans and advances, and payroll export.

tags.name: Performance Management (PMS)
tags.description: Review templates, self-assessments, manager reviews, performance notes and warnings, recurring assignments.

tags.name: PMS Compliance & Attendance Blocking
tags.description: Tracks whether managers finished their reviews and (when switched on) blocks their team's check-in until they do.

tags.name: Recruitment (ATS)
tags.description: Candidates through the hiring pipeline: create/edit, resume upload with auto-fill, status changes, documents, recordings, dashboard activity and the AI overview.

tags.name: Jobs & Employee Referrals
tags.description: Job postings (with salary and referral visibility switches) and employee referrals.

tags.name: Assessments
tags.description: Create online tests, invite candidates/employees, and the public token-link pages candidates use to take them.

tags.name: Learning (LMS)
tags.description: Courses, modules and lessons, assignments, progress and completion for admins, managers and employees.

tags.name: Daily Work Plans
tags.description: Employees' daily plans and the team/analytics views built from them.

tags.name: Clients & Client Drive
tags.description: Client records, shared folders/files and manual updates.

tags.name: Team Chat
tags.description: Direct messages, channels, unread counts, presence (heartbeat) and typing indicators. The web app polls these every few seconds.

tags.name: AI Assistant
tags.description: Text/voice assistant that answers questions using the caller's own permissions.

tags.name: Announcements, My Profile & Uploads
tags.description: Company announcements (with attachments) and the caller's own profile and profile picture.

tags.name: Notifications
tags.description: Badge counts and today's birthdays.

tags.name: Dashboard Statistics
tags.description: Admin dashboard numbers and the end-of-day automatic-absent job.

tags.name: Assets
tags.description: Company assets, assignment and employee asset requests.

tags.name: Achievements
tags.description: Employee of the month/quarter/year, awards and hike records.

tags.name: My Goals (Sticky Notes)
tags.description: Personal daily/weekly goals with start date, deadline, sharing and login reminders.

tags.name: Experience Certificates (QR Verification)
tags.description: Generate, reissue and revoke experience certificates and the public QR verification endpoint.

post.description:
One-off repair: every correction request historically carried a bogus
attendance_id ("manual_entry" — a placeholder string sent by both
correction forms, not a real ObjectId). Approving a correction tried
ObjectId(attendance_id) to find the original record, which raised on
that string and was swallowed by the bare except — so the correction
shows "Approved" but the employee's day never actually left LOP/absent.
Both submission forms and _apply_correction_attendance() are fixed now;
this backfills every already-approved correction still missing its
attendance record. Idempotent — safe to call more than once, it skips
anything that already has one (found via correction_ref).
